transforms.name: adapter-step-0
transforms.effect: Monitor updates stay empty. Status is declared supported, but no status family update is written.

transforms.name: adapter-step-1
transforms.effect: user.message starts a turn at interactionId. assistant.turn_start only records an internal id and emits no event.

transforms.name: adapter-step-2
transforms.effect: assistant.turn_end completes the interaction only when that internal turn was marked terminal, which happens when an assistant message had no tool requests. Otherwise the end emits nothing.

transforms.name: adapter-step-3
transforms.effect: abort and session.error fail the current interaction when one exists, and emit no turn event when none exists.

applicability.notes: ROW FIELD field.detail. PENDING DOWNSTREAM MAPPING into MonitorAgentRow. This is one of 74 canonical row fields. It is not an SDK contract leaf. PENDING DOWNSTREAM MAPPING: GV-AUDIT2 owns the step from adapter output to the row. This audit does not perform it.   The correlation is stateful and the record confidence is authoritative. The declaration says the log separates response cycles from user interactions and the adapter joins them by interactionId. That join is derived even though the record confidence is authoritative. Poll default is 100ms. Durable history is replayed by the observer; this audit does not call replay a second live signal. The adapter does not write the row property. Upstream states: adapter.copilot.upstream.turn.started="turn:started" (user.message); adapter.copilot.upstream.turn.completed="turn:completed" (terminal assistant.turn_end); adapter.copilot.upstream.turn.failed="turn:failed" (abort or session.error with a current interaction); adapter.copilot.upstream.turn.ignored-end="no event" (turn_end that is not the terminal internal turn) Continuation: MonitorService.consume then core reduce and project, then deriveAgentRow.
